alarms.title: Destination tank high-high
alarms.consequence: Continued transfer would exceed the teaching model's destination operating envelope.
alarms.operator_response: Verify destination level and transfer state; stop transfer if the condition is credible; investigate any disagreement between level, flow and command state.
alarms.rationale: A high-high level is a distinct abnormal condition that should drive protective transfer logic in the teaching model.

alarms.title: Source tank low-low
alarms.consequence: The source is nearly depleted and pump operation may no longer be meaningful in the model.
alarms.operator_response: Stop or inhibit transfer and verify source level and pump condition.
alarms.rationale: Separates depletion from ordinary low-level indication.

alarms.title: No flow with pump and valve feedback
alarms.consequence: Equipment feedback says the transfer path is active while the measured process response is absent.
alarms.operator_response: Compare command, feedback, Modbus I/O, actual model flow and sensor-bias/fault state before assigning a cyber cause.
alarms.rationale: A process-integrity alarm linking equipment state to measurement; delay reduces nuisance alarms during normal run-up.

alarms.title: Bus under-frequency
alarms.consequence: Generation and demand are not balanced in the teaching AC-bus model.
alarms.operator_response: Check online generators, breaker feedback, total load, reserve and load-shed actions.
alarms.rationale: Frequency is the primary dynamic indicator of active-power imbalance in this simplified model.

alarms.title: Power bus unavailable / blackout
alarms.consequence: The teaching electrical bus is unavailable; Cargo/propulsion dependencies may be lost.
alarms.operator_response: Establish source/breaker state first; follow the training recovery sequence rather than randomly restarting loads.
alarms.rationale: A distinct top-level plant state requiring immediate operator attention.

alarms.title: Low spinning reserve
alarms.consequence: A further load increase or generator loss could cause a larger frequency excursion.
alarms.operator_response: Review load forecast and generator availability; verify automatic second-generator logic.
alarms.rationale: Early operational warning; delayed to avoid alarming on short expected transients.

alarms.title: Low lube-oil pressure while engine running
alarms.consequence: Insufficient lubrication can damage engine/shaft machinery in the represented control concept.
alarms.operator_response: Verify pressure, pre-lube/engine state and the lube-pump fault input; remove engine enable through the designed protective sequence.
alarms.rationale: Based on the real marine concept that low lube-oil pressure is an engine safety condition.

alarms.title: High coolant temperature
alarms.consequence: The thermal state is outside the teaching operating envelope.
alarms.operator_response: Reduce load and inspect cooling/load state; confirm the measurement trend rather than reacting to one sample.
alarms.rationale: Slow process variable; delay and clear delay prevent a noisy boundary alarm.

alarms.title: Engine overspeed
alarms.consequence: Excessive shaft/engine speed is a protective condition in real marine engine-control systems.
alarms.operator_response: Remove propulsion enable/fuel through the protective sequence and verify speed feedback/control demand.
alarms.rationale: Fast protective condition; short activation delay.

alarms.title: Cargo process-source telemetry unavailable
alarms.consequence: The operator/learning layer cannot confirm fresh process state for this domain.
alarms.operator_response: Verify process runtime health and the communications path before trusting stale displayed values.
alarms.rationale: This Teaching Alarm Chronicle entry covers loss of the direct process-runtime source. OPC UA/historian freshness is evaluated independently.

alarms.consequence: The operator/learning layer cannot confirm fresh process state for this domain.

alarms.title: Cargo transfer requested while electrical power is unavailable
alarms.consequence: The Cargo controller/process requests pumping but the selected vessel profile has removed Cargo electrical availability.
alarms.operator_response: Check PMS bus availability, Cargo load-shed state and generator/breaker condition before investigating the Cargo pump itself.
alarms.rationale: Makes a cross-domain cause explicit so a power event is not misdiagnosed as a Cargo control failure.

alarms.title: Generator 1 commanded but unavailable
alarms.consequence: The expected primary generator has not reached or retained the ready state.
alarms.operator_response: Check prime-mover run-up, trip state and whether an alternate generator is available before closing a breaker.
alarms.rationale: The activation delay suppresses the expected starting transient but exposes a persistent failed-start/trip condition.
